Use case: style-transfer. Transform the character in the PRIMARY local portrait into the established RimWorld/Arknights mod pawn texture style. The supplied local Lilya / 红弩箭 portrait is the identity authority. Use the reference pawn board only for simplification, proportions and strong outer line hierarchy; do not borrow other characters' colors, clothes, facial markings or expression. No realistic anatomy shading, gradients, specular shine, tiny textures, complex hair filaments or overpolished anime rendering. Transparent background, no chessboard painted in, text, border, ground, shadow, extra character or contact sheet. This is one isolated game asset.
Asset: HEAD ONLY, front / south orthographic view, centered and UPRIGHT, no tilted head or three-quarter pose. NO torso, clothes, shoulders, skin shoulders, arms, hands or neck respirator; the respirator is exported with the body separately. Identity: pale golden/straw-blonde long loose layered hair, simplified into a few flowing chunky pointed locks, reaching about a head-length below the chin. Asymmetric side-swept thick bang partly covers HER LEFT eye (viewer RIGHT); leave some turquoise/blue-green iris visible. Brown leather aviator cap with tan forehead flap, two small pointed fur-lined ear-shaped cap peaks, silver-grey framed goggles with muted amber lenses resting on the CAP above forehead (not over her eyes), small gold star on HER RIGHT cap temple (viewer left). Calm half-open blue-green eyes, relaxed mildly raised eyebrow, NOT a frown, angry sharp eyebrows, sadness, blank neutral face, open-mouth laughter or an exaggerated cute baby expression. Keep a readable tiny nose and shaped lip line, compact softly tapered short chin, simple game-pawn eyes comparable in width/spacing to board faces. No freckles, scars or burns. Sparse internal hair contours, bold face/hair outer boundary. Keep the skull/face size compact even with long hair. One whole head-hair silhouette, ample transparent margin, cap/hair tips not cropped.
